(2) solicit and take orders for the sale of liquor from permittees authorized to import liquor for the purpose of resale; and
(3) if the agent represents the holder of a nonresident seller's permit, provide samples or tastings of distilled spirits on a retailer's premises as authorized by Section 37.01(d).
(b) A person acting as a nonresident seller's agent may only represent one permitted or licensed business at a time while soliciting or taking orders.

items.t: INELIGIBILITY TO SERVE AS AN AGENT
l: A person acting as a nonresident seller's agent may not act as an agent under Chapter 35.
A nonresident seller's agent may not transport or carry liquor as samples, but may carry or display empty sample containers.

items.t: SOLICITATION FROM HOLDER OF MIXED BEVERAGE OR PRIVATE CLUB PERMIT
l: A nonresident seller's agent may not solicit business directly or indirectly from a holder of a mixed beverage permit or a private club registration permit unless the agent is accompanied by the holder of a wholesaler's permit or the wholesaler's agent.

A nonresident seller's agent in soliciting or taking orders for the sale of liquor may not represent that the agent is an agent of a person other than the person who employs the agent or who has authorized the agent to represent the person.

items.t: RESTRICTION AS TO SOURCE OF SUPPLY
l: A nonresident seller's agent may not represent a person with respect to an alcoholic beverage unless the person represented is the primary American source of supply of the beverage as defined in Section 37.10.
